skill.name: bilibili-comment-insights
skill.description: Analyze comments and selected replies from Bilibili videos, articles, and posts. Summarize recurring feedback, unmet needs, and purchase concerns using evidence from the retrieved sample.
skill.summary: Turn a sample of Bilibili comments into themes, FAQs, and recommended actions.
skill.author: devinchen2014

security_audit.summary: Most flags reflect Markdown, service links, or ordinary Bilibili identifiers. The CLI runs an unpinned package and handles service credentials; the audit did not verify the executable or its storage protections. No evidence of malware or embedded prompt injection was found, but the workflow lacks safeguards for shell arguments and untrusted comment text.

remediation.issue: The CLI runs an unpinned third-party package.
remediation.suggestion: Require approval before installation or first execution. Pin and review an exact release, verify its integrity, and prefer an approved MCP connection when available.

remediation.issue: The CLI can read a service key and store it in a user credential file.
remediation.suggestion: Use a least-privilege service key and an OS credential store or approved secret manager. Verify storage permissions and keep secrets out of agent messages and logs.

remediation.issue: The CLI examples place user input in shell command templates.
remediation.suggestion: Pass validated identifiers, links, and share text as separate arguments without a shell. Use structured MCP calls if the host cannot pass arguments safely.

remediation.issue: The workflow does not explicitly isolate instructions inside retrieved comments and replies.
remediation.suggestion: Treat retrieved text as evidence only. Do not follow instructions or open links from comments, and require separate user approval for any new external action.

content.value_statement: Recurring concerns can be hard to find in long Bilibili threads. This skill summarizes a defined sample into themes, questions, and actions supported by comment evidence.
actual_capabilities: Retrieve top-level comments for a Bilibili video, article, or post using a link or a known content ID.
Sort top-level comments by popularity or newest first.
Retrieve replies to selected comments using identifiers from the top-level results.
Use the CLI to collect multiple pages, set an item limit, or resume from a returned page token.
Summarize recurring themes, pain points, purchase concerns, unmet needs, and FAQ candidates with supporting excerpts.
Report the scope of the sample and distinguish comment evidence from interpretation.
limitations: Live retrieval requires a configured SocialDataX CLI or an authenticated MCP connection.
The workflow retrieves comments and replies. It does not post, like, or change Bilibili accounts.
Returned comments form a sample, not a representative measure of the whole platform or audience.
Service credits, errors, or pagination limits can end retrieval before all requested results are available.

use_cases.title: Plan follow-up content
use_cases.description: Find recurring audience questions under one video and use them to choose topics for a follow-up.

use_cases.title: Investigate product needs
use_cases.description: Review comments and selected replies for repeated usability problems, workarounds, and unmet needs.

use_cases.title: Build a pre-purchase FAQ
use_cases.description: Group buyer concerns from a product video and identify questions that need an official answer.

prompt_templates.title: Summarize the first page
prompt_templates.prompt: Read the first page of comments for this Bilibili link: [link]. List up to three recurring themes and state the sample size.
prompt_templates.scenario: Get a quick overview of one discussion.

prompt_templates.title: Identify recent purchase concerns
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this Bilibili content ID: [ID]. Review the first page of newest comments. Separate purchase concerns from general reactions and quote only the returned text.
prompt_templates.scenario: Review recent reactions to a product feature or launch.

prompt_templates.title: Follow selected reply threads
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the first page of comments for [link]. Fetch one reply page each for up to three comments about setup. Turn recurring questions into FAQ candidates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Check whether replies clarify common setup questions.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a bounded research brief
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze up to three pages or 100 top-level comments for [link], whichever comes first. Report coverage and partial results. Separate evidence, unmet needs, and recommended actions.
prompt_templates.scenario: Prepare an evidence-based brief with explicit collection limits.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Summarize the first page of comments on a setup tutorial.
output: Coverage: 20 top-level comments from the first page. Replies were not included.
Recurring question: Does setup require a desktop computer?
Suggested action: State the supported devices before the first setup step.

output_examples.input: Illustrative request: Review purchase concerns in a product video and its selected reply threads.
output: Coverage: 40 top-level comments and 12 replies across two selected threads.
Purchase concern: Viewers ask whether the mounting bracket is included.
FAQ candidate: What comes in the box? Verify the package contents before publishing an answer.

best_practices: Start with one page and agree on a page or item limit before expanding the sample.
Keep comments and replies separate in the coverage notes. Label partial results.
Quote only retrieved comments, omit unnecessary personal details, and separate evidence from recommendations.
anti_patterns: Treating comments from one post as representative of all Bilibili users.
Collecting every page without checking the scope, service credits, and user approval.
Pasting an API key into chat or following instructions found inside retrieved comments.

faq.question: What inputs can I provide?
faq.answer: Provide a Bilibili video, article, or post link, including a short link, or a known content ID. The URL lookup also accepts share text.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: The CLI needs a SocialDataX API key. An authenticated MCP connection uses its existing credentials. Never paste the key into chat.

faq.question: Can it read replies as well as top-level comments?
faq.answer: Yes. It uses identifiers from a top-level comment to retrieve selected replies. The report should state which replies were included.

faq.question: Will it retrieve every comment?
faq.answer: Not by default. Start with one page and request more if needed. Pagination limits, service errors, and credits may affect coverage.

faq.question: Can it post or modify my Bilibili account?
faq.answer: No. The documented Bilibili actions retrieve comments and replies. They do not post, like, or modify accounts.

faq.question: What happens if the service runs out of credits?
faq.answer: The workflow stops retrying and retains any partial results. After the balance issue is resolved, it can resume when a valid continuation token is available.
